menu_options.discover: Search the MQTT broker for devices

discover.title: Discovered Newtron devices
discover.description: Select the device to add. Only devices that answered on the broker are listed.

manual.title: Newtron device topic
manual.description: Enter the MQTT topic of the device — the value of its Topic setting, e.g. SMART8R-1501. Use this when the device is connected to the broker but did not answer the search.

error.no_response: The device did not answer the Discover command on this topic. Check the topic and that the device is connected to this broker.

abort.mqtt_unavailable: The MQTT integration is not set up. Configure it first.
